_comment: DECLARATIVE source of truth for the Hermes Codex-OAuth CODE-WRITER chain (NOT the validator/orchestrator chain - that lives in the gateway plist VALIDATOR_*_CHAIN, verified by verify-hermes-patches.sh section 6c). This manifest is consumed by verify-writer-chain.py (conformance) and writer-served-monitor.py (liveness). It declares the invariants that the writer path must satisfy so a silent Codex->GLM degrade is caught, not discovered hours later. Maintained by hand; the verifier cross-checks each live source against this AND against each other so the manifest itself cannot silently drift from reality.

primary.rationale: ChatGPT-subscription OAuth, flat-fee; Colin's pick (2026-07-12) - documented hang risk covered by runner timeout+failover.

failover.rationale: 1M-ctx, unlimited; the tier the chain SILENTLY drops to when any Codex point drifts. Detecting that drop is the whole point of this manifest.

flag.name: HERMES_WRITER_CODEX
flag.note: NOT carried in the gateway plist. The flag lives in 1Password at op://Dev Toolbox/dev/HERMES_WRITER_CODEX. opencode_exec.py HERMES-PATCH 27 self-heals it into the executor child via the non-interactive service-account SDK resolver in op_sdk_resolve.py; the subprocess sanitizer scrubs the bare env var. Assert against 1Password through the SDK resolver, never through the CLI and never against the live gateway os.environ (the ps-eww boot-env trap still applies).

proxy.note: Local OpenAI-compatible proxy. Injects the OAuth bearer + Codex Cloudflare headers AND strips max_output_tokens. Auto-repair: launchctl bootstrap/kickstart on drift.

strip_shim_8647.note: The separate strip-shim on :8647 was CONSOLIDATED into the codex-proxy (the proxy now strips max_output_tokens itself). Do NOT add a :8647 check - there is no shim. Stale references remain in opencode_exec.py comments and the 2026-06-25 handoff's '5 coupled points' (it is now 4). Documented here so nobody re-adds a phantom :8647 conformance check.

opencode_jsonc.note: Routes OpenCode's built-in openai provider straight at the codex-proxy. If this drifts (e.g. back to api.openai.com) the writer tier hits OpenAI with a placeholder key and dies -> silent GLM. Currently section 18b-jsonc only WARNS on drift; this manifest upgrades it to FATAL. Auto-repair: re-apply from the canonical copy at ~/.hermes/canonical/opencode.jsonc.

oauth_token.validity: access_token is a JWT; decode the middle segment and read the exp claim (epoch seconds). last_refresh (ISO) is a secondary signal. Treat as INVALID if exp is in the past or within a 300s skew window.
oauth_token.note: THE highest-value missing check. active_provider can be correct while the token is expired -> proxy returns 401 -> silent GLM. This is the ONE point that must HARD-REFUSE (alert, do NOT auto-repair): refreshing OAuth needs the codex CLI / Colin, not a mechanical restart.

cascade_source.note: Cross-check: the runtime cascade's first tier MUST equal this manifest's primary, so the manifest and the live code cannot silently diverge.

liveness.degraded_definition: armed (HERMES_WRITER_CODEX=1 as resolved from 1Password by op_sdk_resolve.py) AND served_model != openai/gpt-5.5 - i.e. the Codex primary was expected but a lower tier actually served the run.
liveness.note: opencode_exec.py already computes result['model'] (served tier) + result['failover_tried'] per run but never persists them. The liveness probe appends a record here every run; writer-served-monitor.py reads it and alerts on a silent degrade within minutes.

alerting.dedupe: alert only on STATE TRANSITION (healthy->degraded), mirror ci_health_watch.py STATE_PATH atomic json pattern, so a persistent degrade does not spam every timer fire.
